title: Tabular Data Round-Trip Differ
description: Import a CSV, TSV, or JSON table, edit it, and produce a canonical cell-wise diff plus the modified file with input and output SHA-256 content hashes. Demonstrates the OpenChainGraph import binding and write-back diff (lens get/put round trip). Client-side, deterministic, zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: tabular_roundtrip_differ
mcp_tool_definition.description: Parses a CSV, TSV, or JSON table into a canonical form, accepts edits, and returns a cell-wise diff (row key, column, before, after) plus the modified file and SHA-256 input/output content hashes. Demonstrates a deterministic import-binding and write-back round trip (lens get/put). Client-side only.

importData.description: The raw CSV, TSV, or JSON table text
